name: com.holidayexplore/mcp
title: HolidayExplore Global Banking & Chronometry MCP Server
description: Global statutory holidays, RTGS payment cutoffs, and working days across 48 countries (2026-2027).

tools.name: get_country_holidays
tools.description: Fetches statutory public holidays, bank holidays, and stock market closures for a given 2-letter ISO country code across 48 sovereign countries (2026-2027).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, JP, AU, CA).

month.description: Optional month number (1-12) to filter holidays.

type.description: Holiday classification filter. Defaults to all.

tools.name: check_date_status
tools.description: Checks whether a specific calendar date (or today/tomorrow) is a public holiday, central bank RTGS wire settlement closure, or stock exchange closure in a sovereign country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, JP, SG).

date.description: Target calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or relative keywords "today" or "tomorrow". Defaults to "today".

tools.name: calculate_working_days
tools.description: Calculates net business working days, weekend rest days, statutory public holidays, and total billable work hours between two dates for a sovereign country (accounting for 5-day or 6-day weekend rules).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, CA, IN, AU, DE).

start_date.description: Range start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Range end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

hours_per_day.description: Standard working hours per day. Defaults to 8.0.

tools.name: check_payment_rails_and_markets
tools.description: Checks central bank RTGS wire settlement cutoff status, automated clearing house (ACH) payroll roll rules, and 24/7 instant payment rails across 48 sovereign financial centers.

country.description: Optional ISO country code or country name keyword (e.g. US, Germany, Brazil).

region.description: Optional geographic region filter (e.g. Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa).

rail.description: Optional payment rail filter (e.g. SEPA, Fedwire, ACH, RTP, PIX, CHAPS, BACS, TARGET2).
